label: Adjacent ML researcher
description: Machine-learning researchers from subfields other than speech processing (e.g., NLP, computer vision, RL). Know general deep learning, Transformers, standard supervised training, evaluation practice, and statistics. Do NOT know: ASR-specific terminology (WER, CER, AM, LM, hybrid systems, GMM-HMM), speech-specific datasets (LibriSpeech, CommonVoice, Fleurs, CoVoST2, VoxPopuli), or prior ASR model families (Wav2Vec, HuBERT, CTC).
assumed_knowledge: Standard ML metrics (accuracy, F1, BLEU for translation)
Scaling laws: performance vs. model size and data size
binding_personas: NLP researcher familiar with large language models who wants to understand the speech equivalent of CLIP-style pretraining
Computer vision researcher curious whether weak supervision at scale works as well for audio as for images
